title: Anthropic is courting lawyers to teach AI agents how to negotiate and strike deals like humans
hook_text: Anthropic is teaching AI to negotiate.
script:
Anthropic is actively courting top law firms to teach AI agents how to negotiate corporate deals.
The lab wants its software to master complex human bargaining strategies instead of just writing code.
Lawyers are being brought in to provide real-world training data on high-stakes settlements and contracts.
This initiative aims to push AI agents past basic automation into active corporate dealmaking roles.
Would you let an algorithm negotiate your next major business contract?
